responseMessageContents.text:
The actual PNG images themselves are circular - the mountain illustrations are drawn inside dark blue circles with transparent corners. That's the issue. The component code is fine (borderRadius: 0), but the images themselves have circular designs baked in.

The user wants square icons that fill edge to edge. I need to regenerate all these icons as square images instead of circular ones. That's a LOT of images (100+). 

Let me think about this differently. The user wants the icons to be squares that fill to the borders. The images themselves are circles. I have two options:

1. Regenerate all icons as square images - this would take a very long time with 100+ images


2. Scale up the image so the circle overflows and effectively fills the square container

Option 2 is much more practical. If I scale the image up by about 1.42x and use overflow hidden on the container, the circular image will be cropped to fill the square bounds. I'll update the MountainIcon component to scale the images larger than their containers so the circles get clipped into squares.
